As a Mechanical Maintenance Technician, your responsibilities include: Performing preventive maintenance on production machinery, conveyors, packaging lines, and utilities. Inspecting critical machine components such as bearings, chains, sensors, and seals. Diagnosing and repairing mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and basic hydraulic faults. Testing and releasing equipment after repairs. Carrying out inspections and condition monitoring to identify wear, leaks, unusual noises, and performance issues. Recording maintenance activities and findings in the CMMS. Installing, dismantling, and modifying machine components during maintenance and production changeovers. Assisting with technical improvements and production line optimizations. Working according to HACCP food safety and hygiene standards. Applying Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO) procedures to ensure safe maintenance activities. Collaborating closely with operators, engineers, planners, and fellow maintenance technicians. Supporting continuous improvement initiatives such as 5S, TPM, root cause analysis, and standardization projects. Managing spare parts responsibly and advising on critical stock levels. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A competitive salary based on your experience. A year-end bonus. 25 vacation days. Travel expense reimbursement. An excellent pension scheme. Opportunities for training and professional development. A stable, long-term position within a growing international organization. Functie-eisen You are a proactive technician who enjoys working in a team and takes ownership of technical challenges. You work safely, accurately, and have a strong focus on quality. You also have: An MBO Level 3 or 4 diploma (or international equivalent) in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Automation, Installation Technology, or a related technical discipline. Experience in industrial maintenance within a production or manufacturing environment. Knowledge of mechanical drives, bearings,

chains, gears, pneumatics, and basic hydraulics. Basic understanding of PLC inputs and outputs (programming experience is not required). Experience working with motors, sensors, frequency drives, and conveyor systems. Experience using a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) is an advantage. A valid VCA certificate, LOTO training, and NEN 3140 certification are beneficial, or willingness to obtain them. Good communication skills in English. Dutch is an advantage but not required. Hier kom je te werken As a Mechanical Maintenance Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring our production and packaging lines operate safely, efficiently, and reliably. You will carry out preventive maintenance, resolve mechanical breakdowns, and contribute to continuous improvements while maintaining the highest food safety and hygiene standards.

Jouw baan Join our Housekeeping team at Kimpton De Witt Amsterdam! As a Room Attendant, you play a key role in ensuring that our guests enjoy a comfortable, clean, and welcoming stay in our luxury 5-star hotel. Working in a friendly, international team, you will help create an unforgettable experience for every guest who walks through our doors. What You'll Do: Clean and maintain guest rooms and corridors to the highest standards Work efficiently with a team of 12 to 15 colleagues per day Ensure all amenities are stocked and rooms are welcoming Report any maintenance issues to the Housekeeping Supervisor Working Schedule: Hours: 30-35 hours per week Shifts: 5 days a week between Monday and Sunday, starting at 09:00 Availability: At least 2 weekends per month Check here how a day working with us looks like EW Facility Services For over 30 years, we have been providing cleaning and maintenance services for various types of buildings, including offices, hotels, and hospitals. We take pride in our team of over 3,000 employees, who work hard every day at different locations across the Netherlands. Our goal is to make a positive impact on the experience of employees, guests, and visitors of our clients through our services. Logistic worker Fulltime - Oostrum - € 14,99 - 19,26 per uur - 40 uur, 5 dagen per week - Basisonderwijs - Flextronics Logistics B.V. 
Ready to boost your career and get your EPT certificate for free? At Flextronics Logistics in Oostrum, you'll join an energetic team with great pay . Full-time work, good vibes, and endless opportunities. What are you waiting for? Apply today and let's roll! 
 what we offer 
 Hourly wage that can increase to €19,26 in shifts! 
 Opportunity to obtain an EPT certificate! 
 Weekly salary! 
 Nice colleagues and good working atmosphere! 
 Travel expenses € 16.80 per day! 
 36-hour guarantee! 
 who you are 
You are a proactive worker with a positive mindset. Additionally: - You speak Dutch or English. - You have your own transport. - You are physically able to lift boxes up to 20 kilos if necessary. - You are available within a week. - You are full-time available - You are available in 2 shifts. - You can work in Oostrum. 
 what will you do 
At Flex, no two days are the same. Every shift kicks off with a cup of coffee and a chat with your teammates. After that, you take charge as the essential link in our logistics chain: - Order Picking: Collecting the right products with precision. - Packing: Ensuring everything is packed securely and ready for transport. - Checking: You are the final checkpoint for shipments and documentation. - All-Round Greatness: From administration to physical handling, you manage it like a pro. 
 where will you work 
Working at Flex means becoming part of a huge family. With over 750 colleagues, we make sure every day is a success. We look beyond just the tasks; we look at you. Want to move up? We'll help you climb the career ladder. We believe working with a smile is just as important as hitting your targets! 
The Extras: - Pension plan for your future. - Shift bonuses for evenings and weekends. - Real opportunities for career advancement.
